title: Coast to Coast call drops at the lost-time question
summary: Richard Barth tells of Coast to Coast call drops at the lost-time question, about unspecified at Coast to Coast AM radio, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He wanted to know if I had had any lost time during the event and I was going to answer him and everything just went blank.

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at a US nuclear missile site who says he was taken by aliens, says he was once on Coast to Coast AM, a late-night radio show about the unexplained, with host George Noory and researcher Robert Hastings, author of the book UFOs and Nukes. He says that when he was asked whether he had any "lost time," a gap in memory during the event, and he started to answer, the line suddenly went dead. He tells it as if something did not want him to say it.
